ask_vision_describe_image: ask the vision API to describe the content of an image using Claude backend
ask_vision_openai_backend: ask the vision API to analyze an image using OpenAI backend with custom proxy
ask_vision_modelscope_qwen: ask the vision API to describe an image using ModelScope Qwen3-VL backend
prepare_image_resize_encode: prepare an image by resizing it to max pixels and encoding to base64 JPEG
call_claude_vision_api: call the Claude vision API with a base64 image and text prompt to get a description
